proposals.statement:
theorem rowNat_succ_mod_two_pow_congr (s t n : ℕ)
    (h : rowNat s % 2 ^ n = rowNat t % 2 ^ n) :
    rowNat (s + 1) % 2 ^ n = rowNat (t + 1) % 2 ^ n := by
  sorry
proposals.reason: Autonomy of the low bits of the packed row is what makes the wall a statement about a finite system, and every computational or structural attack on it starts by citing this.

route.tactics:
have key : ∀ r i, ((4 * r) ^^^ ((2 * r) ||| r)).testBit i
    = xor (decide (2 ≤ i) && r.testBit (i - 2))
        ((decide (1 ≤ i) && r.testBit (i - 1)) || r.testBit i) := by
  intro r i
  have h4 : 4 * r = 2 ^ 2 * r := by norm_num
  have h2 : 2 * r = 2 ^ 1 * r := by norm_num
  rw [h4, h2, Nat.testBit_xor, Nat.testBit_or, Nat.testBit_two_pow_mul,
    Nat.testBit_two_pow_mul]
have hstep : ∀ r, ((4 * r) ^^^ ((2 * r) ||| r)) % 2 ^ n
    = ((4 * (r % 2 ^ n)) ^^^ ((2 * (r % 2 ^ n)) ||| (r % 2 ^ n))) % 2 ^ n := by
  intro r
  apply Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq
  intro i
  rw [Nat.testBit_mod_two_pow, Nat.testBit_mod_two_pow, key, key]
  by_cases hi : i < n
  · have h1 : i - 1 < n := by omega
    have h2 : i - 2 < n := by omega
    simp [Nat.testBit_mod_two_pow, hi, h1, h2]
  · simp [hi]
show ((4 * rowNat s) ^^^ ((2 * rowNat s) ||| rowNat s)) % 2 ^ n
  = ((4 * rowNat t) ^^^ ((2 * rowNat t) ||| rowNat t)) % 2 ^ n
rw [hstep (rowNat s), h]
exact (hstep _).symm

proposals.statement:
theorem rowNat_mod_two_pow_eq_of_eq (n T p : ℕ)
    (h : rowNat T % 2 ^ n = rowNat (T + p) % 2 ^ n) :
    ∀ t ≥ T, rowNat t % 2 ^ n = rowNat (t + p) % 2 ^ n := by
  sorry
proposals.reason: Once the low bits return they repeat for ever; this is the induction that turns a single kernel-checked congruence into periodicity of every diagonal below that depth.

route.tactics:
intro t ht
induction t, ht using Nat.le_induction with
| base => exact h
| succ t _ ih =>
  rw [show t + 1 + p = (t + p) + 1 by omega]
  exact rowNat_succ_mod_two_pow_congr t (t + p) n ih

proposals.statement:
theorem leftDiagonal_periodicFrom_of_rowNat_return (k T p : ℕ)
    (h : rowNat T % 2 ^ (k + 1) = rowNat (T + p) % 2 ^ (k + 1))
    (i : ℕ) (hi : i ≤ k) (N : ℕ) (hN : T ≤ N + i) :
    PeriodicFrom (leftDiagonal i) p N := by
  sorry
proposals.reason: The bridge from a return of the truncated row to settled diagonals: with T = 2k, p = 2^k, N = k it is the wall at depth k, and with any concrete T, p it makes each instance of the wall a kernel computation.

route.tactics:
intro n hn
rw [leftDiagonal_eq_rowNat_testBit, leftDiagonal_eq_rowNat_testBit]
have hmod := rowNat_mod_two_pow_eq_of_eq (k + 1) T p h (n + i) (by omega)
have key : ∀ m, (rowNat m).testBit i = (rowNat m % 2 ^ (k + 1)).testBit i := by
  intro m
  rw [Nat.testBit_mod_two_pow]
  simp [show i < k + 1 by omega]
rw [key (n + p + i), key (n + i), show n + p + i = n + i + p by omega, hmod]

proposals.statement:
theorem periodicFrom_trans_period (f : ℕ → Bool) (p q N M : ℕ) (hp : 0 < p)
    (h1 : PeriodicFrom f p N) (h2 : PeriodicFrom f q M) : PeriodicFrom f q N := by
  sorry
proposals.reason: A period known from a late onset holds from any earlier onset that has some positive period; the wall gives an early onset with an unknown period and leftDiagonal_periodicFrom_pow a late onset with period 2^k, and this puts the two together.
proposals.disclaims: About Bool sequences in general; nothing about rule 30.

route.tactics:
intro n hn
have hM : M ≤ M * p := Nat.le_mul_of_pos_right M hp
have a := periodicFrom_mul f p N h1 M (n + q) (by omega)
have b := periodicFrom_mul f p N h1 M n hn
have c := h2 (n + M * p) (by omega)
rw [← a, ← b, ← c]
congr 1
omega

proposals.statement:
theorem leftDiagonal_onset_le_iff_rowNat_return :
    (∀ k, ∃ p > 0, ∃ N ≤ k, PeriodicFrom (leftDiagonal k) p N) ↔
    ∀ k, rowNat (2 * k) % 2 ^ (k + 1) = rowNat (2 * k + 2 ^ k) % 2 ^ (k + 1) := by
  sorry
proposals.reason: The onset wall is exactly one congruence per depth, in both directions, so a proof of the wall may work entirely on the orbit of 1 under the truncated bit map and lose nothing; the right-to-left half alone is what a proof of this node would cite.
proposals.disclaims: An equivalence between two ways of writing the wall; both sides are open.

route.tactics:
constructor
· intro h k
  apply Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq
  intro i
  rw [Nat.testBit_mod_two_pow, Nat.testBit_mod_two_pow]
  by_cases hi : i < k + 1
  · obtain ⟨p, hp, N, hN, hper⟩ := h i
    obtain ⟨M, _, hpow⟩ := leftDiagonal_periodicFrom_pow i
    have hq : PeriodicFrom (leftDiagonal i) (2 ^ i) N :=
      periodicFrom_trans_period _ p (2 ^ i) N M hp hper hpow
    have hk : PeriodicFrom (leftDiagonal i) (2 ^ k) N := by
      have := periodicFrom_mul _ (2 ^ i) N hq (2 ^ (k - i))
      rwa [← pow_add, show k - i + i = k by omega] at this
    have this := hk (2 * k - i) (by omega)
    rw [leftDiagonal_eq_rowNat_testBit, leftDiagonal_eq_rowNat_testBit,
      show 2 * k - i + 2 ^ k + i = 2 * k + 2 ^ k by omega,
      show 2 * k - i + i = 2 * k by omega] at this
    rw [this]
  · simp [hi]
· intro h k
  exact ⟨2 ^ k, Nat.two_pow_pos k, k, le_rfl,
    leftDiagonal_periodicFrom_of_rowNat_return k (2 * k) (2 ^ k) (h k) k le_rfl k (by omega)⟩

proposals.statement:
theorem leftDiagonal_onset_le_of_le_5000 (k : ℕ) (hk : k ≤ 5000) :
    ∃ p > 0, ∃ N ≤ k, PeriodicFrom (leftDiagonal k) p N := by
  sorry
proposals.reason: The wall at every depth up to 5000 as a theorem, by one kernel computation over the packed rows; the first proved instances of the wall on the board, and seven times past the measured range.
proposals.disclaims: Evidence for the wall, not the wall: says nothing at depth 5001. The kernel check needs `set_option maxRecDepth 100000 in` and `set_option maxHeartbeats 4000000 in` before the theorem.

route.tactics:
have h : ∀ k ≤ 5000, rowNat (2 * k) % 2 ^ (k + 1) = rowNat (2 * k + 16) % 2 ^ (k + 1) := by
  decide +kernel
exact ⟨16, by norm_num, k, le_rfl,
  leftDiagonal_periodicFrom_of_rowNat_return k (2 * k) 16 (h k hk) k le_rfl k (by omega)⟩
